reason: E119 Mathematik fuer Ingenieure 1 (polynomials, complex numbers, limits, derivatives, linear systems, vectors) plus E120 (integration, eigenvalues) cover nearly all of this engineering maths 1 content
No EMI module teaches Rust or profiling/tracing; E087 Informatik 2 teaches modern systems programming in C++ with tools and testing (same main topic), E166 adds testing basics

E022 covers NoSQL and distributed data and E034 relational basics, but data representation, encodings, REST/GraphQL/gRPC and RDB optimisation are missing; topic named by T185 Modern Databases and NoSQL
E006 Angewandte Systemtechnik (Laplace, LTI systems in time and frequency domain) plus E158 Regelungstechnik (state space, transfer function, frequency response) cover the system theory content
E165 Simulation dynamischer Systeme covers only MATLAB/Simulink simulation of technical systems; stochastic, discrete-event, Monte Carlo, PDE methods and model validation are missing

E116 Mathematik 1 (linear algebra basics) and E118 (eigenvalues) cover linear systems, determinants, eigenvalues only; complex vector spaces, normal forms and quadratic forms at this level are missing
No EMI module teaches optimisation, linear programming, duality or simplex; E001/E002 cover only the algorithm runtime and graph basics
E022 Big Data, Cloud & NoSQL covers cloud service concepts and architecture, but Go, microservices, containers and deployment are not taught at EMI
E090 Informationsethik und Technikphilosophie covers IT and society questions; E199 Wissenschaftliches Arbeiten covers literature work and scientific writing
E012 Automatisierungstechnik Grundlagen (automation systems, control concepts) plus E171 Speicherprogrammierbare Steuerungen (PLC programming) cover most; EE and measurement basics are only recapped

No EMI module on shape-memory alloy or dielectric elastomer actuator design (E134 Physical Computing only uses sensors/actuators); smart-material and rapid-prototyping work needs equipment not in the EMI lab list
PR and journalism research (communication science, empirical study design) is not taught at EMI; E029 Cross Media and E181 TV-Produktion are media production, not communication research
E060 Foreign Language 1 is an English/German course at B2/C1 with technology texts; technical English vocabulary and presentations are general language content
E129 Mobile and Ubiquitous Computing covers IoT protocols and sensor prototyping, but Industry 4.0 concepts and IoT business models/use cases (about half) are not covered
Assembly system engineering (joining, handling, feeding, tolerance management) is production engineering; no EMI module or timetable subject has it (E077/E162 robotics only touch handling)
E029 Cross Media (cross-media concepts, consistent messages across media) plus E154 Projektmanagement und agile Entwicklungsmethoden (project management, Scrum) cover the crossmedia project
E119 (limits, differentiation, complex numbers) plus E120 (integration, ordinary differential equations) cover it; multivariable differentiation (E121) is the missing part
E001 Algorithmen & Datenstrukturen teaches complexity analysis, divide and conquer, dynamic programming and standard data structures at the same level
E167 Software Engineering 2 (XP, Scrum, TDD, continuous integration) plus E154 (Scrum, Kanban, team project) teach the same agile content
E093 Informationsvisualisierung plus E032 Data Analytics (data mining, exploratory analysis) cover visualisation and ML building blocks; the visual analytics reference model is extra
